He asked the professor one question. The room applauded.

Kevin Trudeau tells how he raised his hand in a Harvard Business School lecture and asked what business the professor owned. The answer: none. The professor had learned it from people who never owned one either.

Kevin says he told him he had done the opposite and still did well, then walked out as the students applauded.

Would you take advice from someone who has never done it?

#ad #success #business #mindset

Most people secretly believe money is bad.

Kevin Trudeau says surveys show most people answer that having a lot of money is bad. He argues that belief sits deep in our memory, and it can work against us when we want more.

His answer: it is the love of money that is the root of evil, not money itself. You can do wonderful things with money.

What did you grow up hearing about money?
